title: GRAVEL BIKE CAMP GX700 2026 MEWAH

takeaways.text: T700 carbon frame with internal down-tube storage, five frame mount points and three on the fork, plus a front-derailleur mount and routing for converting the GRX 1× setup to 2× (Indonesian, automatic captions).
Stock Maxxis Rambler 45C tan-wall tires still left visible room in the frame; the maximum was not stated.
The 173 cm presenter (77 cm inseam) fitted the size 48.
The retailer gives 9.9 kg for the size 48 complete without pedals; it was not weighed on camera.

disclosure: Published by an Indonesian bike shop that sells the bike and links its marketplace listings; the shop owner and a CAMP distributor representative appear in the video.
summary: Indonesian retailer walkaround of the 2026 CAMP GX700 complete with Shimano GRX 1×12, sizing and weight (Indonesian, automatic captions).
